meta.title: Halal butcher in Amiens | Boucherie Musulmane, rue du Général Leclerc
meta.description: Neighbourhood halal butcher since 1988 at 53 rue du Général Leclerc, Amiens: lamb, beef, veal, chicken, merguez, family meat boxes and Eid orders. Click & collect, cut to order. Rated 4.8/5 on Google.

items.q: How far ahead should I order?
items.a: Order by 6 pm the day before to collect the next day, at the time of your choice. For meat boxes and large quantities, let us know two or three days ahead. For Eid, bookings open several weeks before.

items.q: Can you cut the meat the way I want?
items.a: Yes. Tell us in your order how you'd like it: sliced, diced for tagine or couscous, minced, or on skewers. Add a note if you have a preference, such as the thickness of the slices.
You pay in the shop when you collect. Nothing is paid online: you see your meat before you pay.

items.q: Where does your meat come from?
items.a: The origin of every meat is shown in the shop, as the law requires. Ask us at the counter or by phone and we'll tell you where your cut comes from.

items.q: Is my order confirmed straight away?
items.a: You get a summary on screen, and by email if you give us your address. If something is missing or the time doesn't work, we'll call you.
We're open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7.30 pm. For Sundays, please call +33 9 83 49 94 40 before coming.
